acceptance_limits: The two intended business jobs did not produce two current reports: first failed, second published one report which became stale; a third unintended job started.

67 total attempts = 39 initial + 27 after sell + 1 shutdown-cancelled unexpected task. 64 complete terminals, one idle timeout, one RemoteProtocolError, one shutdown cancellation; no outcome excluded.

Second-round successful ordinary request 107.515s exceeds old 90s, successful final 210.695s exceeds old 120s. These prove those complete streams survived the old thresholds, not the overall two-report acceptance.
Client sent manager max, successful response reported high. All 19 such differences across both rounds are kept explicit; no client effort downgrade occurred.
No provider log matching or invoice; response IDs are retained where available, header request IDs were absent. Costs remain unknown.
No hidden reasoning text, API key, prompt, source article text, or credential reference is copied to this audit.
